measurement_gate.COHORT_SCOPE: GLOBAL_UNION (enrolled at the first sampled frame over the union of all detected components; for SINGLE_DISC the union IS the single component, so union == track here)
measurement_gate.evidence: advance_passive_tracer advects the labelled cohort through the engine ledger's ACTUAL gross matter flows (matter_forward/matter_reverse x matter_scale) using the local labelled fraction tracer/pre_matter; it re-derives expected_post = pre - dt*div(net) and REFUSES any pre/post inconsistency, enforces 0 <= tracer <= matter, and asserts exact fsum conservation.
measurement_gate.evidence_tracker: detect_components thresholds state.m only; the tracked-component rule uses area and centroid only; no code path reads the tracer.

operator.name: STATE_MATCHED_OPEN_RESERVOIR_EXCHANGE
operator.SINK_OPERATION: remove mass from cells of the frozen downstream half of the INITIAL disc that are currently occupied AND currently inside the tracked component; the removed payload is exactly the cell mass
operator.SOURCE_OPERATION: place exactly the removed mass into frozen upstream cells that are currently vacant (m<0.45), have free capacity (m_max - m > 0) and have NO 4-neighbour inside the tracked component; filling respects m_max = 1.0, spilling to the next frozen source cell in priority order
operator.CONSERVED_QUANTITIES: total matter exactly (removed == injected, measured balance error 0.0); cardinality of paired transfer events exactly
operator.INTERVENTION_TIMING: before the engine step, at frames 272, 288, ..., 1536 (80 events, cadence 16)
operator.CONNECTIVITY_RULE: 4-connectivity for the separation test; the detector's own periodic connectivity for components
operator.RNG_BEHAVIOR: a dedicated intervention RNG (default_rng(7)) is drawn identically in every arm including SHAM; the engine RNG is never touched (the engine is deterministic)
operator.quota_rule: q_e = floor(e*Q/80) - floor((e-1)*Q/80); sum(q) == Q exactly (verified 404 and 1432)
operator.SHAM: SCHEDULE_AND_INSTRUMENTATION_SHAM — same schedule, same quotas, same intervention RNG draw, no physical mutation. It is NOT a mechanical sham of the ablation itself.

source_band_choice.narrow_annulus_pilot: dist <= (r+3), delivers ~43-60 of 404 cells; the disc SURVIVES with residual 0.72
source_band_choice.wide_upstream_halfplane_pilot: entire upstream half-plane outside the disc, delivers 60-107; the disc is DESTROYED around frame 368-464
source_band_choice.rationale: capacity, not outcome: the narrow annulus caps delivery at ~0.27*N0, which makes the frozen criterion (>=0.80*N0) arithmetically unreachable and collapses the dose factor (FLOW_2N and FLOW_4N would deliver identically). I state plainly that BOTH pilots were observed before freezing and that this choice was made after seeing them, on capacity grounds. It selects the configuration in which the disc DIES, i.e. it works AGAINST a positive result, so it is not outcome shopping.

design.seed_rule: 940000 + 100*size_index + k, DEV_SINGLE_DISC_SOURCE_SINK_00, fresh, disjoint from 91xxxx/92xxxx/93xxxx, permanently excluded from any primary, reproduction or holdout

joint_criterion.name: JOINT_EXCHANGE_PERSISTENCE_H2048
clauses: same track continuously valid from 256 to the horizon
0.5*N0 <= tracked_mass <= 1.5*N0 at 1536 and 2048 (frozen prospectively, no canonical window existed)
no direct injection into the track (enforced by the 4-neighbour separation filter)

no_double_counting.unique_egress: count of sink cells driven below the occupancy predicate while inside the track; each removal is a distinct physical act at a distinct time and site
no_double_counting.unique_ingress: max over checkpoints of fresh-provenance mass inside the track, divided by the mean initial cell mass. The running MAXIMUM never double counts material that oscillates in and out; it is a conservative LOWER bound on ingress.

decision_rules: as specified in the mission, applied in order, primary cell LAW_16 x FLOW_2N
